intro.text: Aprea is a clinical-stage precision medicine oncology company focused on the discovery and development of targeted therapies for patients with biomarker-defined cancers. The Company is pursuing an approach to treating cancer that seeks to exploit vulnerabilities associated with cancer cell mutations. This approach is designed to kill tumor cells while minimizing the effect on normal, healthy cells. Aprea believes its technology has potential applications across multiple cancer types, including ovarian, endometrial, colorectal and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The Company’s lead program is APR-1051, an oral, small molecule inhibitor of WEE1 kinase, currently in a Phase 1 clinical trial.
